questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with bit A pointing to the LEFT with the solved board configuration, describe the path of the blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (4, 1), then bit at (5, 2), then ramp_left at (4, 3), then ramp_left at (3, 4), then ramp_left at (2, 5), then ramp_right at (1, 6), then ramp_right at (2, 7), then ramp_right at (3, 8), then ramp_right at (4, 9), then ramp_right at (5, 10), and is caught at the right exit.

questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with bit A pointing to the RIGHT with the solved board configuration, describe the path of the balls.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (4, 1), then bit at (5, 2), then ramp_left at (4, 3), then ramp_left at (3, 4), then ramp_left at (2, 5), then ramp_right at (1, 6), then ramp_right at (2, 7), then ramp_right at (3, 8), then ramp_right at (4, 9), then ramp_right at (5, 10), and is caught at the right exit.

questions.question: Based on the starting state of bit A, what color ball gets intercepted?
questions.answer: 2 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits right, intercepted. 0 exit left, 1 exit right, 1 is intercepted.
